new.statement: Games built around cash-tycoon money mechanics stay on Most Popular for fewer days
new.action: Skip cash-tycoon loops for staying power

new.statement: Games whose median game pass costs more than 399 Robux monetize more efficiently
Young escape and flee games climb Top Trending more slowly than other games of similar age
Young games selling luck products hold lower Top Trending positions among games of similar age
Games with a core competitive loop rank higher on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age
Durable PvP hits sell identity rather than power: weapon skins (Hypershot, RIVALS), paid roles and teams (Asylum Life) and character rosters (ABA, Strongest Battlegrounds) carry their monetization
new.action: Sell cosmetics and roles, not power
new.rationale: Six of the 16 analysed long-running hits are PvP, and their videos show cosmetic or role purchases rather than stat boosts. More PvP videos, plus a product-name feature that separates cosmetics from boosts, would test it against Top Earning efficiency.

qualitative_updates.note: Hypershot's trailer centres on heavy hit effects and skin close-ups over simple arenas; another long-running hit fits the pattern.
Mixed today: Steal Animal Egg fell 16 on Most Popular and steal games are among the weakest there, yet two new steal-egg titles entered Most Popular and Steal An Egg still leads.
